annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 91/368/EEC of 20 June 1991 amending Directive 89/392/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to machinery
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 91/368/EEC of 20 June 1991 amending Directive 89/392/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 198
annotation.summary_en: 1991 Council Directive amending the original EU Machinery Directive 89/392/EEC to add essential health and safety requirements for mobile machinery, lifting operations and underground machinery, extend scope to interchangeable equipment, and set transposition dates and repeals. Foundational machinery safety law, not AI-specific.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds essential safety requirements for mobile machinery, including remote-controlled machinery that must stop automatically if control is lost
Adds lifting-operation requirements covering stability, load testing, and marking
Treats interchangeable equipment as machinery requiring EC mark and declaration of conformity
Member States apply the measures from 1 January 1993, with transitional arrangements
Repeals earlier directives on ROPS, FOPS and self-propelled industrial trucks
